overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics highlights a dominant audience preference for extreme astronomical anomalies and speculative 'What If' planetary scenarios, particularly those featuring liquid diamonds, extreme darkness, and unconventional planetary physics (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y, v1rrcZLdp4U, A9Qa-RmuOr0). Conversely, short-form psychological tricks and standard anatomical trivia underperform in views-per-day velocity compared to high-concept space curiosities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (YlDuGu1vzAg) drove top-tier view counts (824-1029 views) and strong engagement (38 likes, 2 comments) within shorter windows relative to older historical or standard fact posts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-friction hypothetical space scenarios that force an immediate mental visualization challenge.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing extreme planetary states like 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (v1rrcZLdp4U) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) consistently cross the ~1,000 view threshold with high like ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more deep-space content focused on rare, counter-intuitive physical properties of newly discovered celestial bodies.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5-53 views) and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' (71 views) show significantly lower velocity and engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological tricks unless paired with a heavy high-strangeness micro-mystery narrative.

weak_patterns.evidence: Simple biological facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (excluding outlier 05kbZHfzuyg) generated modest traction compared to exotic cosmological threats.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot animal content toward cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary anomalies rather than basic trivia.

Must feature a completely new celestial body (Rogue Planet / Interstellar wanderer).
